newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's domestic debt total falls at end-May.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's domestic debt total falls at end-May.

text.p: Turkey's total domestic debt fell to 4,026 trillion lira at end-May from 4,061 trillion lira a month ago, the treasury said on Tuesday.
It said bonds with maturities of at least one year made up 2,743 trillion lira of the total domestic debt stock in May, up from 2,576 trillion in April.
Debt due to t-bills having less than one year maturities was 838.7 trillion lira, down from 1,022 trillion lira.
The treasury's cash advance from the central bank fell to 444 trillion lira in May from 471 trillion lira.
